etl_logic: JOIN security_trading_snapshot ON security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol = foreign_ownership_information.ticker_symbol AND security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = (SELECT MAX(t2.trading_dt) FROM security_trading_snapshot t2 WHERE t2.ticker_symbol = foreign_ownership_information.ticker_symbol AND t2.trading_dt <= make_date(foreign_ownership_information.rpt_year, foreign_ownership_information.rpt_month, foreign_ownership_information.rpt_day)) [dedup bản ghi cuối phiên: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC) = 1 — tránh nhân dòng khi security_trading_snapshot có nhiều bản ghi trong phiên] WHERE foreign_ownership_information.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_INFO' → foreign_ownership_information.current_foreign_holding_quantity * security_trading_snapshot.close_price
source_entity: Foreign Ownership Information / Security Trading Snapshot
source_attribute: Current Foreign Holding Quantity / Close Price
